description: What is your vision for your future? #careeradvice #lifebydesign #30something #bigsisteradvice #IntentionalLiving #fyp
transcript: One of the hardest conversations that I have with myself is what is the vision? What are we doing? Because the way in which I operate and flexible, I can swing left or right and be happy either way. And that has afforded me a lot of opportunities and that has opened a lot of doors for me. But the more that I think about my system, the more that I think about the organization within my internal world, I find myself leaning towards what is the actual vision and how do we want to do this and where do we want to go. And as I start this Monday, I'm starting it with strategy. I'm starting it with critically thinking. I am really focused on what we are doing and where we are going and what doors are we going to allow to close, what are we finished with and where are we going.
